description: Get one fiscal year by id, with its start and end dates. bokio_list_fiscal_years returns all of them in one call.

companyId.description: Bokio company id. Defaults to BOKIO_COMPANY_ID if omitted.

fiscalYearId.description: Id from bokio_list_fiscal_years; an unknown id returns a not-found error.

name: bokio_get_fiscal_year
